integrity: The theorem is proved using the published matching classification and a new relative-collapse and rotation argument. Finite computation checks cases n=2,3,4 but does not replace the infinite proof. Bibliographic priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The collapse order need not be equivariant; only the action on integral top homology and rational homology of the half-turn quotient is determined. Original homotopy classification is due to Bayer, Jelic Milutinovic and Vega. An unindexed equivalent computation remains possible.
title: A half-turn invariant simplex-boundary core in honeycomb perfect-matching complexes
